definitions.explanation: A category of household waste that can be incinerated, as defined by municipal garbage collection systems in Japan. Includes paper, food scraps, and certain plastics.

examples.japanese: {燃|も}えるゴミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{火曜日|かようび}→火曜日：00640_kayoubi⟧だ。
{燃|も}えるゴミ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{燃|も}えないゴミ→燃えないゴミ：23525_moenaigomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please separate burnable and non-burnable garbage.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{燃|も}えるゴミ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{何回|なんかい}→何回：08497_nankai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: A large amount of burnable garbage came out during the move, so I put it out in several batches.

notes:
USAGE:
An essential daily-life term in Japan, where garbage is strictly sorted by category. {燃|も}えるゴミ is one of the main categories, along with ⟦{燃|も}えないゴミ→燃えないゴミ：23525_moenaigomi⟧ (non-burnable garbage) and ⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ (recyclable waste). Collection days and sorting rules vary by municipality. Also written as ⟦{可燃|かねん}→可燃：26077_kanen⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ on official signs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {燃|も}えるゴミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (burnable garbage day)
- {燃|も}えるゴミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧ (burnable garbage bag)
- {燃|も}えるゴミ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out as burnable garbage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{燃|も}えないゴミ→燃えないゴミ：23525_moenaigomi⟧: non-burnable garbage — metals, ceramics, glass
- ⟦{可燃|かねん}→可燃：26077_kanen⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧: combustible waste — formal equivalent
- ⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧: recyclable waste — paper, cans, bottles, plastics
